data.name: duck-diff
data.tagline: Automated CI/CD data diffing & visual lineage engine
data.description: Constant-memory reconciliation engine powered by DuckDB SQL. Headless CI/CD telemetry tracking surfaces automated regression detection across data pipelines, with a scheduled daily health dispatch to Discord — the same telemetry that feeds this page.

data.name: sqlean-lint PRO
data.tagline: Local-first SQL static analysis & AST mutation CLI
data.description: SQL AST linter and rewrite tool built on Python + SQLGlot. Multi-dialect linting, query tree inspection, and automated anti-pattern rewrites keep high-throughput analytical SQL canonical and safe to mutate.
